title: Hinomori Shizuku — A Comforting Breakfast〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: The Lumina Forum - Cafeteria

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Nom-nom... I have to eat these fast...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're gonna choke if you don't take your time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gag*
*Cough*

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Seriously, what did I just say?

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line:
A-Are you okay, Hanasato...?!
Here, have some water.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-Thanks...!
Phew...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We still have some time, so there's no need to rush.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: <Your first task will be announced in the main ballroom in one hour! We ask those who are interested in participating to please be there! See you then!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Lumina Time... What do you think they're going to have us do?

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line:
I don't know...
It's a grand prix, so some sort of battle would be appropriate, no?

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Maybe a dance or singing battle?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But this is Ms. Arisawa we're talking about, so I've gotta think she's gonna throw us a few curveballs.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She did go out of her way to set up a whole training camp facility just for this program.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What if we're asked to do something really hard? What do we do then...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Whatever it is, it'll be a chance to prove ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And this is the first one, so it's sure to get a lot of attention.

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: Some people are probably going to decide which groups to support based on their first impressions.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which means we need to do our best to get off to a good start.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Everyone is so motivated...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I need to be ready for whatever they throw at us.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Starting with recharging my batteries by finishing this meal.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm? What's wrong, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This miso soup...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It tastes so wonderful...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The broth they used has such a gentle flavor to it. And these daikon slices just fall apart in your mouth.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
I didn't mean to change the subject so suddenly.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: There's no need to worry about that.

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: Are you a fan of miso soup, Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. So much so that I'll bring some in a thermos from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, you do like to have miso soup during practice.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: Wait, during practice...?

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Umm... I've never heard of this before, but is it one of the secrets behind your beauty, Hinomori...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, it's nothing like that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I just like to have something that's soothing whenever I'm feeling tired. It also helps warm my body back up after I've been cooled by sweat and replenishes my electrolyte reserves.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Plus, I can change the broth or ingredients I use to keep things fun and interesting.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: R-Right...

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
It is interesting when you put it that way!
I feel like giving it a try now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I hope you find a miso soup recipe that you truly enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: That I truly enjoy... Then, I might try clam miso soup since it's supposed to be good for your skin!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I also wanna give that a try!

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: Adding some protein supplements could conceivably work...

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: What? You're joking, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She might be right...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You really just helped settle our nerves, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I feel a lot more relaxed now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: After talking so much about it, I feel like having some miso soup now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. You did get the sandwich set today, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I know what you mean.
I think I'll get a bowl as well.

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line:
Oh...
In that case, can we join you?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Let's all go together.
I'm also looking to get a refill.
